messages:
Rohan: Quick heads-up — planning to roll out model-serving v2.3 to prod tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Staged rollout (us -> eu) with canary gates. Observability changes will ship with the deploy: a new dashboard for v2.3, adjusted token-latency alerts, and a temporary increased trace sampling during the canary window. Please ack if you can be on smoke checks.

Ana: I can lead the deploy window (09:00 UTC). I'll own the rollback call if anything flares.

Maria: I'll take US smoke at 09:05 (10m after canary starts). Will run the quick perf and correctness scripts.

Sam: I'll cover EU region at the 09:20 step. Free to join Ana on the rollback decision if needed.

Kevin: FYI I pushed the dashboard JSON to the grafana repo (branch: serving/v2.3-obsv). Main changes: separate panel for token_latency p50/p95/p99, and a heatmap for inference duration by model_shard. Also adjusted an alert: token_latency_p95 threshold moved from 200ms -> 220ms during warmup.

Maria: Can you add a short note in the panel description about the threshold change? Want engineers to know it's intentional.

Kevin: Yep — added note and PR link: https://git.internal/grafana/dashboards/pulls/45 :thumbsup:

Rohan: Rollout plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with 10m waiting periods. Automatic rollback triggers: error_rate > 2% sustained for 2m OR p99 latency > 1s for 2m. Manual rollback by Ana/Rohan if we see unexpected regressions.

Sam: For smoke tests, I'll run the usual quick-check script and a small-batch inference run. Steps below (reuseable):
```
# smoke script (run from deploy box)
./scripts/smoke_checks.sh --endpoint https://prod.redwood.com --samples 50
# short manual test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":10}'
```

Maria: Also will capture traces for first 10m at 100% sample rate, then back to 5% after we hit 100% rollout. Adds: tracing sampling toggle in the tracing UI under the v2.3 experiment.

Kevin: Added a temporary alert to paging (noticing only) — high_trace_errors if spans.error_count > 5 in 5m. Only for the canary window and auto-disabled after 30m post-100% rollout.

Rohan: Who can confirm rollback script is ready on standby? I want one-liner rollback: ./deploy/rollback_v2.3.sh --region=us

Ana: Confirmed. Script exists and has been dry-run. I also added a safety flag that requires me to ack before it runs to avoid accidental triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff scheduled by Ana at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z. Notifications will post to #eng and #oncall when each stage completes.

Sam: Quick Q: alert noise expected for first 2 minutes because of cold-starts — we should ignore the first 2m for p95 trends. Can we tune alert evaluation to 3m window?

Kevin: Good call. I'll change the token_latency alert to evaluate over a 3m window during rollout. Will keep p99 stricter.

Maria: I'll run the perf histogram export and post a short summary in this thread after US smoke.

Rohan: Great. If no objections, proceed with current timings. Please leave a short "ready" message in this thread when you are set. Also tag any additional people if they want to watch (e.g., platform-sre).

Ana: ready

Maria: ready

Sam: ready

Kevin: ready — dashboard PR merged and alert tweak pushed to monitoring (feature flagged to rollout window).

Rohan: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final checklist reminder 30m before the window and drop the deploy checklist here.

Maria: post-smoke summary — US canary passed basic correctness (50/50 acceptance), p95 210ms, p99 640ms. No increase in error rate. Captured traces uploaded to tracing UI.

Sam: EU canary completed — small spike in cold-start latency during first minute, then stable. No functional regressions.

Ana: Rollout to 100% complete, turning off elevated trace sampling. Leaving token_latency alert at the adjusted thresholds for 24h.

Rohan: Closing the thread — no rollback required. Will follow up with a short postmortem if any customer-facing abnormalities show up. Thanks all.
